name: Michael
source:
[url=/c175728]Flynn[/url]'s father. He's devoted majority of his life into researching the disappearance of the Scions and deities. As an archeologist, he gets access to a lot of ancient temples and ruins that may be connected to the divine. Because of this, he's always leaving to study them and was hardly around during Flynn's upbringing.

[Edited from in-game description]
